policyname: Public read access for active media placements
qual:
((active = true) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM media_assets ma
  WHERE ((ma.id = media_placements.media_id) AND (ma.status = 'active'::text) AND (ma.bucket = 'cp-public'::text)))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_media.product_id) AND (p.status = 'published'::text))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_media.product_id) AND has_tenant_role(p.tenant_id, ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'editor'::text, 'manager'::text]))))
with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_media.product_id) AND has_tenant_role(p.tenant_id, ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'editor'::text, 'manager'::text]))))
